comment: Copy to leader_map.json next to leader_decoder.py (gitignored) and fill in.
Per joint: sdk_deg = sign * continuous_deg + offset_deg, then converted to radians.
offset_deg  leader angle that must map to the vendor zero for this joint.
unwrap      true if the joint travels more than one full turn.
calibrated  must be true before app.py will accept --backend sdk.
Values below are placeholders, not a calibration.
